# Martian Security

> Customer documentation for red teaming, Evals, the SDK and CI.

These public Markdown documents require no login or JavaScript. Each guide retains its version, role prerequisites and qualification limits. A partly verified walkthrough is not a passed walkthrough.

## Start here

- [Run your first assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/first-assessment.md?v=f6160f4e6eb2): Complete a small endpoint-only assessment and inspect the recorded result.

- [Run your first evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/first-run.md?v=18e92035bdbf): Connect an approved HTTP agent, prepare a small published dataset, and inspect a retained evaluation result.

- [Install and configure the SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/install-and-configure.md?v=587f1ec3d05b): Install the Martian SDK, create a scoped API key, and connect Python or CI to your organization.

- [Guide verification record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/verification.md?v=95f3e4e3181a): Review source revisions, real captures, completed checks and remaining gaps.

## Documentation

- [Martian Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/index.md?v=efa5b660195b): Practical customer guides for red teaming, evaluations, and the Martian SDK.

- [Connect an agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/agents/connections.md?v=de776812d84f): Register, validate and approve an HTTP, MCP or browser target, then manage its connection safely.

- [Add an HTTP chat adapter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/agents/http-adapter.md?v=bdcd97c4ccac): Run a complete callback-backed HTTP service, preflight its contract, and provide the public HTTPS endpoint required by console onboarding.

- [Connect an agent to sandbox systems](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/agents/sandbox-bindings.md?v=b34f70fb9525): Configure a session-capable HTTP agent using a complete payment-system binding and independent duplicate-refund checks.

- [Configure a red-team assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/configure.md?v=b5d17695d1ed): Choose the current wizard's environment, agent, goals, coverage and execution settings without overstating readiness.

- [Inspect assessment evidence and results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/evidence-and-results.md?v=63dd7ceef79d): Read reports, trace turns, findings, probe coverage and independent outcome checks at the correct evidence level.

- [Find recorded runs and export reports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/history-and-exports.md?v=a7d1aeab01c9): Use Assessments, Findings, Reports and Replay to inspect persisted history and choose the appropriate export.

- [Follow progress and stop a run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/progress-and-cancellation.md?v=03f8943467ea): Track an admitted assessment, distinguish execution from security outcome and handle cancellation or uncertain submission.

- [Understand reproduction and coverage limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/assessments/reproduction-and-limits.md?v=55b8c91e6806): Distinguish observed replies, independently verified effects, clean reproduction, negative controls and incomplete coverage.

- [Business workflow abuse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/business-workflow-abuse.md?v=4519c8530128): Test refunds, credits and claims against persisted application rules rather than relying on the agent's reported success.

- [Data exfiltration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/data-exfiltration.md?v=9442113cf842): Distinguish unauthorized data access, disclosure and outbound transfer, and verify each against the intended data boundary.

- [Denial of service and resource exhaustion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/denial-of-service.md?v=3dce6dd127b8): Understand excessive token, tool, time and cost consumption, with bounded testing and explicit availability limits.

- [Direct prompt injection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/direct-prompt-injection.md?v=45919b646ac3): Examine instruction overrides, roleplay, multi-turn pressure and encoded requests in the attacker's own input.

- [Guardrail and judge evasion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/guardrail-judge-evasion.md?v=94a5ec905135): Test whether a safety boundary or evaluator can be manipulated by the material it is supposed to assess.

- [Human manipulation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/human-manipulation.md?v=448361bdc10f): Inspect deceptive agent messages and approval requests against the exact action a person is being asked to authorize.

- [Indirect prompt injection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/indirect-prompt-injection.md?v=eb1a93f71c16): Test attacks delivered through retrieved documents, emails, pages and tool results rather than the legitimate user's request.

- [Jailbreaks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/jailbreaks.md?v=6764ad622470): Understand attempts to bypass a model's safety restrictions and distinguish unsafe output from verified downstream effects.

- [MCP and tool poisoning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/mcp-tool-poisoning.md?v=5ecc29c12a99): Examine malicious tool descriptions, schemas and runtime responses while keeping transport support separate from attack-surface control.

- [Memory and context poisoning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/memory-context-poisoning.md?v=ac134f85a753): Investigate whether attacker-controlled material can persist through retrieval, summaries, memory or later conversations.

- [Multi-agent attacks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/multi-agent-attacks.md?v=f1ff92b687d1): Inspect malicious instructions, identity claims and permission changes that cross worker, supervisor or agent-to-agent boundaries.

- [Privilege escalation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/privilege-escalation.md?v=152120f71294): Test role claims, confused-deputy behavior, delegation and approval boundaries against actual authenticated authority.

- [Prompt injection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/prompt-injection.md?v=612e36f74cd8): Test whether untrusted text or media can become instructions and redirect an agent's authorized task.

- [Reasoning and alignment subversion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/reasoning-alignment-subversion.md?v=b2ea1dbe74f9): Examine manipulated objectives, reasoning context and feedback without treating a model's explanation as proof of its internal process.

- [Supply chain and backdoors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/supply-chain-backdoors.md?v=540be53e11bb): Understand attacks introduced through dependencies, tools, skills, models and updates, and the limits of endpoint-based testing.

- [Tool and action abuse](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/attacks/tool-action-abuse.md?v=c1419fc47752): Examine unsafe tool selection, arguments and call chains, and verify whether the resulting operation actually occurred.

- [Review and activate an SDK call block](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/call-gates.md?v=60eefd1aaa5e): Enroll a customer-operated gate, review one exact target, activate a timed block and resume calls without confusing it with network isolation.

- [Connect sources and inspect inventory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/inventory.md?v=2e434c96b25e): Enroll an authorized read-only source, follow collection status and distinguish observed agents from candidates and supporting workloads.

- [Set up network observation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/network-observation.md?v=3f55f871d3d9): Prepare a short-lived capture grant or enroll a continuous customer observer, then inspect reporting health and evidence limits.

- [Inspect runtime activity and blast radius](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/discovery/runtime-and-blast-radius.md?v=6c2f7fdd8496): Connect a reporter to one workload version, inspect observed calls and compare them with collected access evidence.

- [Create and launch an environment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/environments/create-and-launch.md?v=6582eb706c62): Save a supported business environment, prepare synthetic data, launch sandboxes and verify assessment readiness.

- [Compare evaluation runs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/compare.md?v=824f022d5391): Pair records from two completed runs, inspect output changes, and compare compatible scoring jobs.

- [Create and publish datasets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/datasets.md?v=0a6d1bc52cfb): Import, edit, validate and version organization datasets, and make editable copies of Martian datasets.

- [Run your first evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/first-run.md?v=18e92035bdbf): Connect an approved HTTP agent, prepare a small published dataset, and inspect a retained evaluation result.

- [Collect human reviews](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/human-reviews.md?v=1f1cfb404798): Create typed review queues, answer required questions, verify completion and retain reviewer history.

- [Score saved outputs and define judges](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/judging.md?v=6a0d9156b0b7): Apply code criteria or versioned model rubrics to completed outputs with explicit cost and provenance controls.

- [Read the Evals dashboard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/overview.md?v=e3855e82f9d1): Interpret project trace volume, errors, latency, recorded usage and typed quality summaries without rerunning a target.

- [Organize evaluation projects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/projects.md?v=a37f80789375): Select, create and archive projects while preserving organization boundaries and historical evaluation evidence.

- [Investigate quality issues](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/quality-issues.md?v=e286aba130ef): Find recorded execution errors and failed Boolean assessments, inspect their evidence, and retain attributed triage decisions.

- [Turn failed results into regression cases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/regression-cases.md?v=14554b1990fb): Copy a saved failure into an editable dataset draft, or import its exported records while preserving the correct expected answer.

- [Understand results and scores](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/results-and-scores.md?v=625d22e991fb): Inspect record-level outputs, exact-match results, supplementary assessments, exports and evaluation provenance.

- [Stop runs and recover uncertain work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/stopping-and-recovery.md?v=b8360ca3703e): Stop target evaluations or saved-output scoring cooperatively, preserve retained evidence, and resolve uncertain submissions safely.

- [Use scoring suites and monitoring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/suites-and-monitoring.md?v=48ad1464d813): Save immutable scoring criteria and thresholds, apply an exact suite version, and inspect retained quality-gate history.

- [Annotate a native trace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/trace-annotations.md?v=320d8f7cbcc1): Add typed human feedback or an expectation to a retained trace and recover an uncertain save without creating a duplicate.

- [Inspect traces and sessions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/evals/traces-and-sessions.md?v=4740fd894967): Search native trace evidence, inspect spans, group recorded sessions, save views and export bounded results.

- [MITRE ATLAS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/mitre-atlas.md?v=2771d2c9ff99): Use ATLAS tactics and techniques to describe AI attacks while keeping Martian catalogue IDs, framework references and execution evidence separate.

- [MITRE ATT&CK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/mitre-attack.md?v=a9571edd0212): Relate AI attack evidence to conventional infrastructure behavior without confusing ATT&CK, ATLAS and Martian identifiers.

- [NIST AI RMF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/nist-ai-rmf.md?v=52e458d76c06): Place Martian testing evidence within Govern, Map, Measure and Manage without treating a library lens as a complete risk program.

- [OWASP Agentic Top 10](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/owasp-agentic.md?v=e03900513045): Understand official Agentic risk names, native Martian tags and the boundaries involved in tools, identity, memory and coordination.

- [OWASP LLM Top 10](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/frameworks/owasp-llm.md?v=f40dffa38137): Use the OWASP LLM application risks to organize testing, with explicit limits on Martian tags and executable coverage.

- [Accept an invitation and sign in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/access.md?v=dbe38b258898): Join the correct organization, sign in, and check your available role.

- [Red teaming and Evals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/concepts.md?v=ac3b95f5bb44): Understand the evidence, records, and workflows before your first run.

- [Editions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/editions.md?v=9ad1da281c45): What Community, Enterprise and On-Premises include, and which parts are available, in beta or planned.

- [Run your first assessment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/first-assessment.md?v=f6160f4e6eb2): Complete a small endpoint-only assessment and inspect the recorded result.

- [Community quickstart](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/get-started/quickstart.md?v=6ee3bc0949e3): Install the free SDK, run a first eval suite on your own machine and read its result, with no Martian account.

- [Attack library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/library/attacks.md?v=e092829f58cf): Understand major AI attack families, find related Martian techniques and use MITRE ATLAS, OWASP and NIST references accurately.

- [Use the Attack Library and coverage views](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/library/coverage.md?v=19e07b68baef): Explore catalogued techniques, distinguish runnable coverage from reference material and understand the current Threat Intel view.

- [Find your way around the console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/console-navigation.md?v=544357b96ab4): Locate every customer console area, its guide and the boundary between available workflows, templates and previews.

- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/glossary.md?v=017f44f48482): Plain definitions for the words used in Martian customer workflows.

- [Budgets, limits and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/limits.md?v=8fe0d4195159): Understand bounded execution, stopping, provenance and evidence coverage.

- [Roles and permissions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/permissions.md?v=18189b055d81): Check the minimum role for each customer task.

- [Supported agent targets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/supported-targets.md?v=b9be5b3ee824): Choose an interface supported by the workflow you intend to run.

- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/troubleshooting.md?v=2bc24b880a68): Resolve common access, connection, run, dataset and scoring failures safely.

- [Use these docs with an AI assistant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/using-with-agents.md?v=3b2004ac5113): Copy a complete page or share a public Markdown link that an assistant can read without signing in.

- [Guide verification record](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/reference/verification.md?v=95f3e4e3181a): Review source revisions, real captures, completed checks and remaining gaps.

- [Gate CI on Evals and redteam](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/ci.md?v=c7f51b51e806): Run evaluations and adversarial probes in one persisted CI session, verify its result, and retain safe reports.

- [Evaluate with Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/evaluations.md?v=683f7c3c4ae9): Run a free local Evals preview, then evaluate a published dataset and verify its saved Backend result.

- [Install and configure the SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/install-and-configure.md?v=587f1ec3d05b): Install the Martian SDK, create a scoped API key, and connect Python or CI to your organization.

- [Run evals locally with a suite file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/local-evals.md?v=8ecdea996036): Run an eval suite from one YAML file on your own machine, using deterministic checks and LLM judges with your own model key.

- [Run a redteam probe](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/sdk/redteam.md?v=1a0f27e2f216): Validate and execute a bounded adversarial test against a local callback, inspect safe reports, and apply a strict gate.

- [Invite teammates and understand roles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/markdown/workspace/team-and-roles.md?v=c14a737969d8): Join the correct workspace, issue a scoped team invitation and understand the owner, admin, member and viewer boundaries.

## Complete reference

- [All documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MorningHQ/martian-security-docs/main/public/llms-full.txt?v=6b39305aede9): all 70 pages in one text file.

- [Website](https://docs.martiansecurity.ai/): the human-readable site. The Markdown mirror is an independent HTTPS access path.
